name: Quadriceps Setting
instructions: Sit in a chair with your leg extended, or lie flat on your back
Keep your leg straight with knee fully extended
Tighten your thigh muscle by pressing knee down
Hold for 5 seconds while breathing normally
expected_sensations: Tightness in front of thigh, no knee pain
progression_criteria: Can hold 10 seconds pain-free for 3 sessions

modifications.easier: Hold 3 seconds, reduce to 5-8 reps
modifications.harder: Add ankle weights, hold 10 seconds

name: Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat on back with one leg bent for stability
Tighten thigh muscle of straight leg
expected_sensations: Thigh muscle working hard, no knee pain
progression_criteria: Can complete 15 reps with good form for 3 days

modifications.easier: Lift only 3-4 inches, reduce reps to 5-8
modifications.harder: Add 1-2 lb ankle weight, hold 5 seconds

name: Heel Slides
instructions: Lie on back or sit with legs extended
Slide heel toward buttocks, bending knee
expected_sensations: Gentle pull in back of knee and thigh
progression_criteria: 5-10 degree improvement over 2 weeks

modifications.easier: Place towel under heel, use hands to assist
modifications.harder: Add gentle pressure with hands, hold 10 seconds

name: Seated Knee Extension
instructions: Sit in sturdy chair with back supported
expected_sensations: Burning in front of thigh, fatigue after 10+ reps
progression_criteria: Can perform 15 reps with full extension for 3 sessions

modifications.easier: Partial extension only, fewer reps
modifications.harder: Add ankle weight 1-3 lbs, hold 5 seconds

name: Wall Slides (Mini Squats)
instructions: Slowly slide down by bending knees
expected_sensations: Muscle burning in thighs and buttocks
progression_criteria: Can do 12 reps to 45 degrees with good form

modifications.easier: Squat only 15-20 degrees, hold 2 seconds
modifications.harder: Hold 10 seconds, squat to 60 degrees

name: Standing Hamstring Curls
instructions: Stand behind chair holding lightly for balance
Bend affected knee, bringing heel toward buttocks
expected_sensations: Back of thigh working, some fatigue
progression_criteria: Can do 15 reps with full ROM and good balance

modifications.easier: Reduce ROM, hold chair with both hands
modifications.harder: Add ankle weight, perform without chair

name: Ankle Pumps
instructions: Sit or lie with legs extended
expected_sensations: Light stretch in calf and shin, increased warmth
progression_criteria: Maintenance exercise - continue regularly

modifications.easier: Smaller range, slower pace
modifications.harder: Add ankle circles

name: Clamshells
instructions: Lie on side with knees bent 90 degrees
Stack knees on top of each other
expected_sensations: Burning on outer hip/buttock
progression_criteria: Can do 15 reps per side with good form

modifications.easier: Reduce ROM, fewer reps
modifications.harder: Add resistance band, hold 5 seconds

name: Step-Ups (Low Step)
instructions: Step up with affected leg first
Push through heel to lift body
Bring other foot up to meet it
Step down with unaffected leg first
expected_sensations: Significant muscle work in thigh and buttock
progression_criteria: Can do 12 reps on 4-inch step with good form

modifications.easier: 2-3 inch step, hold rail with both hands
modifications.harder: Increase to 8 inches, remove hand support, add hand weights

name: Sit-to-Stand
instructions: Sit at edge of chair, feet hip-width apart
Push through heels and stand smoothly
Lower back to sitting with control
expected_sensations: Strong muscle work in thighs and buttocks
progression_criteria: Can do 12 reps with good form, minimal hand support

modifications.easier: Higher chair, push off armrests, cushion on seat
modifications.harder: Lower chair, arms crossed, hold standing 3 seconds

name: Terminal Knee Extension
instructions: Tie band around sturdy object at knee height
Push knee backward to straighten fully
expected_sensations: Strong contraction in front of thigh, especially inner quad
progression_criteria: Can do 15 reps with moderate resistance

modifications.easier: Lighter band, reduce reps, sit for support
modifications.harder: Increase resistance, hold 5 seconds

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand facing chair or low step
Place heel on chair with knee straight
Keep back straight and chest up
Reach toward elevated foot until gentle stretch
expected_sensations: Gentle pulling along back of thigh
progression_criteria: Increased flexibility, can use higher surface

modifications.easier: Lower surface, reduce forward lean, 15 seconds
modifications.harder: Higher surface, point toes toward shin, 45 seconds

name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Stand next to chair for balance
Bend affected knee, bring heel toward buttocks
Keep knees together and thighs parallel
expected_sensations: Gentle pulling along front of thigh
progression_criteria: Can hold 30 seconds comfortably, improved flexibility

modifications.easier: Use towel around ankle, lie on side, 15 seconds
modifications.harder: Stand without support, press hips forward, 45 seconds

name: Wall Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing wall with hands at shoulder height
Place affected leg behind with heel on ground
Front leg bent, back leg straight
Lean into wall for calf stretch
Bend back knee for deeper muscle stretch
expected_sensations: Pulling in calf muscle
progression_criteria: Increased flexibility, back leg moves further from wall

modifications.easier: Stand closer to wall, 15 seconds
modifications.harder: Increase distance, 45 seconds

name: Standing IT Band Stretch
instructions: Stand sideways to wall, affected leg closest
Place hand on wall for support
Lean upper body away from wall
expected_sensations: Pulling along outer thigh and hip
progression_criteria: Increased flexibility, reduced lateral knee tightness

modifications.easier: Don't cross as far, 15 seconds, sit for supported version
modifications.harder: Deeper cross, increased hip push, 45 seconds

name: Single-Leg Balance
instructions: Lift other foot 1-2 inches off ground
expected_sensations: Muscle engagement throughout leg, some wobbling normal
progression_criteria: Can balance 30 seconds without support, minimal wobbling

modifications.easier: Hold support, just shift weight, 5-10 seconds
modifications.harder: Close eyes, soft surface, add arm movements

name: Prone Knee Flexion
instructions: Lie face down on bed or mat
Place small pillow under hips if needed
Keep both legs straight to start
Bend affected knee, bringing heel toward buttocks
expected_sensations: Gentle stretch in front of knee and thigh
progression_criteria: Increased flexion, can touch heel to buttocks

modifications.easier: Reduce ROM, use hands to assist, thicker pillow
modifications.harder: Add ankle weight, hold 5 seconds

name: Mini Lunges (Stationary)
instructions: Hold chair for balance if needed
Take small step forward with affected leg (12-18 inches)
Bend both knees, lowering straight down
Stop at 45-60 degrees front knee bend
Front knee over ankle, not past toes
Push through front heel to return
expected_sensations: Significant muscle work in front thigh and buttock
progression_criteria: Can do 10 reps per leg with good form

modifications.easier: Smaller step (6-8 inches), 30 degrees depth, hold support
modifications.harder: Deeper lunge (90 degrees), remove support, hold 3 seconds

name: Seated Marching
instructions: Sit tall in chair with feet flat
Place hands on chair for support if needed
expected_sensations: Gentle muscle work in front of hip and thigh
progression_criteria: Can do 30 total marches with good posture

modifications.easier: Lift only 2-3 inches, slower pace, use arm rests
modifications.harder: Lift higher, faster pace, hold 3 seconds, ankle weights

name: Supine Hip and Knee Flexion
instructions: Bend affected hip and knee, bringing knee toward chest
Use hands behind thigh to assist if needed
Pull knee as close to chest as comfortable
expected_sensations: Gentle stretch in hip and buttock area
progression_criteria: Increased ROM, knee closer to chest comfortably

modifications.easier: Bring knee only partway, use towel to assist
modifications.harder: Pull closer, hold 10 seconds, both knees together
